newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka's Sampath Bank gets new head.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka's Sampath Bank gets new head.

text.p: Sampath Bank Ltd will have a new chief executive officer from January 1, 1997, a company statement said on Wednesday.
"Kumar Abayanayaka has been appointed general manager-chief executive officer from 1st January, 1997," it said.
Abayanayaka, now senior deputy general manager, has 30 years' banking experience and has been with Sampath Bank since its inception in the first quarter of 1987, the statement said.
A blue chip, Sampath Bank is one of four private commercial banks listed in Colombo.
